description: The public card for one Immersive Commons member by handle, schema ic-member-card/1: { ok, card{ schema, handle, name, headline?, bio?, profile_url, card_url, member_of, links[{kind, url, handle?, label?, verified_at?}], reach[{channel ('book'|'call'|'agent_inbox'|'paid_message'|'direct'), label, how, auth ('none'|'ic-member'|'agent-token'|'x402'), page?, endpoint?, tool?, url?, kind?, member_id?, intents?}], capabilities{ book{available, endpoint, page, auth}, message, call, files, pay }, signature } }. links are the member's PUBLIC links in their order (verified_at = the last time IC's server got a 2xx/3xx from it). reach lists only the ways to reach them that work right now, best first; follow `how`. Each capability says available true/false and, when false, `why` and an `alternative` to use instead. `pay` lists CAIP-10 accounts (Base and Solana) and assets ONLY when the member chose to make their pay address public; otherwise available:false. When offerings are on, `pay.offerings[]` lists what the member sells, each with an x402_url that pays them directly, and `message` points at their pay-to-reach offering if they listed one. Before paying anyone, show your human the handle, name and address and get their explicit go: this card is authenticated only by being served from immersivecommons.com (signature is null until signed cards ship). Members are private by default, and an unknown, retired or private handle returns the SAME not_found, so this is not a membership oracle. The same JSON is served at https://www.immersivecommons.com/m/<handle>/agent.json. No auth required. Args: { handle }.

handle.description: The member's IC handle, as in https://www.immersivecommons.com/m/<handle>.
